messages.subject: discrete latent variable examples
parts:
Hi TMB users,

If anyone is looking for some exercises for a student or just a fun challenge, it would be useful to the community if someone worked out TMB code for models from the book "Bayesian Population Analysis using WinBUGS --- A Hierarchical Perspective" (2012) by Marc Kéry and Michael Schaub. 

They have been worked out in Stan and documented here. 
https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/tree/master/BPA
Similar to TMB, Stan can’t automatically integrate over discrete latent variables, so these examples show how to manually integrate over the discrete latent variables.

Cheers,
Mollie
